Name: Make the Cooking more sense
Author: OceanRambler
Description:
[b]让烹饪更有存在感（中文说明）[/b]
按你真正投进锅里的材料给料理定价。烹饪要耗精力。练级之后菜更值钱、也更顶饱。
作者 OceanRambler · v1.5.0 · 星露谷物语 1.6.15 · SMAPI 4.3.0+ · 内置中英双语提示

[b]这个 Mod 做什么[/b]

[b]1. 料理按你真正用的材料定价。[/b]
原版料理很便宜：不管你把什么放进去，一道菜卖的钱都是配方作者定死的那个数字。这个 Mod 把定价改成每次制作现算。

[code]悬浮价（= 丢进出货箱拿到的钱）=
    Σ(材料标注价 × 材料品质系数 × 数量) × N × 等级倍率 × 成品品质系数 × 其它 Mod 的抬价

商店标价（= 你在皮埃尔那儿付的钱）= 悬浮价 × 2[/code][list]
[*][b]认品质。[/b]铱级奶牛产的奶、金星蛋、银星菜——制作时按你实际放进去的那一份的品质算，不会被平均掉。[/*]
[*][b]其它 Mod 的料理同样认。[/b]凡是 Data/CookingRecipes 里的菜都会自动登记。登记表中还没有的菜，会在你第一次做它的时候用这份配方现场补登记——不需要针对单个 Mod 打补丁，内容 Mod 更新加了新菜也不用等我出适配。[/*]
[*][b]料理当材料会连锁涨价。[/b]成品身上固化的价格会带进下一道菜，所以高阶料理自然把物价抬上去，不会出现「成品比自己的材料还便宜」。[/*]
[*][b]不覆盖其它 Mod 的抬价。[/b]CookingSkillRedux 的 10 级烹饪职业是直接改成品的价格字段，本 Mod 会反推那个比例再乘回去，而不是把它抹掉。[/*]
[/list][b]2. 烹饪消耗精力。[/b]
每次 10 点，烹饪技能每满 2 级减 1 点，最低 1 点（10 级耗 5 点，18 级以上耗 1 点）。没装烹饪技能类 Mod 时固定 5 点。

[b]3. 等级加成（需要 SpaceCore + CookingSkillRedux）。[/b]
[list]
[*]烹饪每满 2 级：成品悬浮价 +5%，回神/回血效果也 +5%，不设封顶。[/*]
[*]10 级以上：有 (等级 − 9) × 10% 概率让成品高一个品质档。[/*]
[*]读不到技能时这三项自动停用，定价和精力照常工作，不会报错。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]必需：[/b]SMAPI 4.3.0 及以上（实测 4.5.2）[/*]
[*][b]可选：[/b]SpaceCore + CookingSkillRedux——开启等级加成和按等级的精力减免。不装也有定价，只是精力固定 5 点。[/*]
[*][b]兼容：[/b]Better Crafting——用它的面板制作一样生效。理论上支持其它mod的料理，在机制上设定了接口，第一制作的新品会被记录，之后再次制作就会采用本mod设定的规则了。[/*]
[/list]解压到 `Stardew Valley\Mods\`，得到：
[code]Mods\CookingBalance\
  CookingBalance.dll
  manifest.json
  i18n\default.json
  i18n\zh.json[/code]首次启动后在 Mod 目录生成 `config.json`。改完[b]必须重启游戏[/b]（读档时才取配置）。

[*]基于 SMAPI 与 Harmony 实现；技能等级读取 SpaceCore 自定义技能（CookingSkillRedux）。[/*]
[*]许可协议：[b]CC BY-NC 4.0[/b]（署名 - 非商业性使用）。可以分享、可以修改、可以放进免费整合包，前提是注明作者 OceanRambler 且不用于商业；拿它卖钱或塞进收费包不在授权范围内。完整条款见压缩包里的 LICENSE 文件。[/*]
[*]反馈问题请附上 SMAPI 控制台输出，以及「你做了什么菜、你以为该卖多少」。多数情况 `cookingbalance_dump 那道菜` 一行就能自己看出来。

—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
[line]
[b]What it does[/b]
[b]1. Dishes are priced from what you actually put in them.[/b]
Vanilla cooked items are cheap: a dish built from three expensive ingredients sells for the same flat number the recipe author typed in, every time, no matter what you used. This mod recalculates it per cook.
hover price (= what the shipping bin pays you) =
[code]    sum(ingredient price x ingredient quality factor x count) x N x level bonus x dish quality x other mods' boost

shop price (= what Pierre charges you) = hover price x 2[/code][list]
[*][b]Quality aware.[/b] Milk from an iridium animal, gold-star eggs, silver-star crops - the ingredient's quality is counted at craft time, not averaged away.[/*]
[*][b]Mod dishes just work.[/b] Any dish from Data/CookingRecipes is registered automatically. A dish that isn't in the registry yet gets registered on the spot the first time you cook it, from the recipe you used - no per-mod patch, nothing to update when a content mod adds recipes.[/*]
[*][b]Dishes used as ingredients chain.[/b] A finished dish carries its own stamped price into the next dish, so high-tier cooking scales naturally instead of collapsing to "cheaper than its own ingredients".[/*]
[*][b]Other mods' price boosts survive.[/b] CookingSkillRedux's level-10 cooking profession raises the finished item's price directly; this mod measures that boost and multiplies it back in rather than overwriting it. Same for any mod that stamps a price on a dish.[/*]
[/list][b]2. Cooking costs energy.[/b]
10 stamina per cook, minus 1 for every 2 cooking levels, minimum 1 (so level 10 costs 5, level 18+ costs 1). Without a cooking skill mod installed it is a flat 5.

[b]3. Skill-linked bonuses (needs SpaceCore + CookingSkillRedux).[/b]
[list]
[*]Every 2 cooking levels: +5% to the dish's sell price [b]and[/b] +5% to its stamina/health recovery. No cap.[/*]
[*]Above level 10: a (level - 9) x 10% chance the finished dish comes out one quality tier higher.[/*]
[*]If the skill can't be found, these three switch themselves off and the mod keeps doing pricing + energy. Nothing breaks.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Required:[/b] SMAPI 4.3.0 or newer (tested on 4.5.2),[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] SpaceCore + CookingSkillRedux - enables the level bonuses and the level-based energy reduction. Without them you still get the pricing and a flat 5 energy cost.[/*]
[*][b]Compatible:[/b] Better Crafting - cooking through its menu works identically.Theoretically, it supports other mods' recipes. Mechanically, interfaces have been set up to handle this. The first newly-made item will be recorded, and subsequent creations will follow the rules set by this mod.[/*]
[*]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15. Should work on other 1.6.x.[/*]
[/list]Unzip into `Stardew Valley\Mods\` so you get:
Mods\CookingBalance\
[code]  CookingBalance.dll
  manifest.json
  i18n\default.json
  i18n\zh.json[/code]`config.json` is generated on first launch. Edit it and [b]restart the game[/b] (settings are read when a save loads).
